response.original_title: How to Add Another Guest to My Carnival Cruise Reservation
response.overview: To add a Guest to an existing Carnival Cruise reservation 1-866-829-1280 you must call 1-866-829-1280 Carnival Cruise Customer Service at 1-866-829-1280 (1-866-Carnival) or contact your travel agent directly. Additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.  Call to Request: 1-866-829-1280 Reach out by phone 1-866-829-1280 with your existing booking number and the new Guest's full legal name and date of birth ready.
